# E0329: patterns that don't cover every value

A `match` covers every value of its type. Add an arm for each case that the message names, or a last `_ => …` arm.

- Rule: [`patterns.non-exhaustive-matches`](../../reference/09-patterns.md#patterns.non-exhaustive-matches)
- Reported at: the `match` or the `try`.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0329:4
type Status = | Pending | Paid | Shipped

fn label(s: Status) -> str {
  match s {
    Pending => "pending"
    Paid => "paid"
  }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
type Status = | Pending | Paid | Shipped

fn label(s: Status) -> str {
  match s {
    Pending => "pending"
    Paid => "paid"
    Shipped => "shipped"
  }
}
```
